methods.title: Bounded large Git-blob canonical read
methods.failure_signature: ENOBUFS on immutable Method Flow Git blob under the default synchronous child-process buffer
methods.candidate_workaround: Set maxBuffer to 32 MiB on every exact Git blob read in the new runner.
methods.recurrence_guard: Inspect the largest immutable blob before one-shot canonical launch and bind a finite buffer above it.
methods.rollback: Keep the route held and preserve the new failed receipt if the correction canonical does not succeed.
